species.visual_review: Inspected both generated sheets, all six normal/shiny native poses and all eight actual production terrain scenes beside the trainer. V1 lost face detail and added a misleading raised tail. V2 removes the third top point and strengthens the copper mask. V3 crop registration preserves two actual frontal source pupils and one real profile pupil in both idle/step views; no pixels were painted. True ear-back/tail rears, broad copper shoulder masses, green patina and heavy tail are coherent with canonical float-copper wolf. Distinct paw steps, transparent native border and all normal/shiny bank pixels verified.
